Sales Database (PostgreSQL)

Only read-only SELECT queries are allowed.

Table: customers
- customer_id (varchar, primary key)
- company_name (varchar)
- contact_name (varchar)
- city (varchar)
- country (varchar)

Table: orders
- order_id (integer, primary key)
- customer_id (varchar, foreign key -> customers.customer_id)
- employee_id (integer, foreign key -> employees.employee_id)
- order_date (date)
- shipped_date (date, nullable)
- freight (numeric)

Table: products
- product_id (integer, primary key)
- product_name (varchar)
- category_id (integer, foreign key -> categories.category_id)
- unit_price (numeric)
- units_in_stock (integer)
- discontinued (boolean)

Table: order_details
- order_id (integer, primary key component, foreign key -> orders.order_id)
- product_id (integer, primary key component, foreign key -> products.product_id)
- unit_price (numeric)
- quantity (integer)
- discount (numeric)

Table: employees
- employee_id (integer, primary key)
- first_name (varchar)
- last_name (varchar)
- title (varchar)
- country (varchar)

Table: categories
- category_id (integer, primary key)
- category_name (varchar)
- description (text)

Relationships:
- orders.customer_id references customers.customer_id
- orders.employee_id references employees.employee_id
- order_details.order_id references orders.order_id
- order_details.product_id references products.product_id
- products.category_id references categories.category_id

Queries run against live PostgreSQL tables in the public schema.
